India Women's Hockey Team Dominates Indonesia 17-1

India's women's hockey team defeated Indonesia with a score of 17-1. Deepika, Rutuja, and Navneet each scored hat-tricks in the match. The team is aiming for direct qualification for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics, which requires winning a gold medal.
